nodeFields.id: Unique identifier for the node (string, required)
nodeFields.label: Display name for the node (string, required)
nodeFields.description: Detailed description of the space (string, optional)
nodeFields.image: Filename of the panorama image (string, required)
nodeFields.nextNode: ID of the next node in sequence (string or null, optional)
nodeFields.initialYaw: Starting horizontal rotation in degrees (number, optional, default: 0)
nodeFields.initialPitch: Starting vertical rotation in degrees (number, optional, default: 0)
nodeFields.nodeOrder: Display order for navigation (number, optional, default: 0)

layerFields.name: Unique name for the layer (string, required)
layerFields.description: Description of the layer content (string, optional)
layerFields.image: Filename of the layer PNG image (string, required)
layerFields.position: Layer position as {x, y} coordinates (object, required, 0-1 range)
layerFields.parallaxFactor: Parallax movement intensity (number, optional, 0-1 range, default: 0.5)
layerFields.scale: Layer scale factor (number, optional, 0.1-10 range, default: 1.0)
layerFields.rotation: Layer rotation in degrees (number, optional, default: 0)

rotationLimits.h: Horizontal rotation limit in degrees (number, 0-180, default: 30)
rotationLimits.v: Vertical rotation limit in degrees (number, 0-90, default: 10)
